allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Migrate seating chart canvas from raw SVG to react-konva

Replace manual SVG rendering and pointer event handling with Konva.js
canvas library for built-in draggable nodes, zoom-to-cursor, grid
snapping via dragBoundFunc, and layered rendering. Key changes:

- FloorPlanCanvas: Stage/Layer architecture with ResizeObserver sizing,
  zoom-to-cursor on wheel, pan via stage drag, click-to-deselect
- TableObject: Nested Group pattern \(outer=position+drag, inner=rotation\),
  Konva Ellipse/Rect/Circle/Text, dragBoundFunc grid snapping
- ElementObject: Same drag/rotation pattern, dash prop for dance floor
- FloorPlanToolbar: Reset button now also resets pan offset
- seating.astro: client:only="react" to skip SSR \(Konva needs window\)
- astro.config: konva/react-konva in optimizeDeps and ssr.noExternal

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
